entries.source: @Target@ is caught by a water siphon!

entries.target: 一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液

entries.source: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
entries.target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔似乎已经有一段时间没吃东西了。
在把它带回来之前请把它清理干净。

entries.source: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
entries.target: 一颗骷髅法师的头骨。它的眼睛已经不再发光了……暂时如此。

entries.source: If the eyes are still glowing, please bash it around a bit until they fade. I'll not have another one of those coming alive and wreaking havoc in my lab.
entries.target: 如果它的眼睛仍然亮着，请猛击它直到不再发光为止。我不想再要一个会突然活过来并把我的实验室搞得一塌糊涂的头骨了。

entries.source: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
entries.target: 一根里奇的螫针，仍闪着毒液的光泽。

entries.source: Keep as much venom in it as possible.
entries.target: 请尽可能多地保留其中的毒液。

entries.source: The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
entries.target: 一颗兽人的心脏。很惊讶吧，它不是绿色的。

entries.source: If you can fetch me a still-beating orc heart, that would be even better. But you don't look like a master necromancer to me.
entries.target: 如果你能给我一个新鲜的、跳动着的兽人心脏，那就太好了。但是在我看来，你不像是一个死灵魔导师。

entries.source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
entries.target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

entries.source: Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity, so if you happen to know any saintly nagas...
entries.target: 最好的结果来自从未被污言秽语亵渎过的舌头，所以如果你正好碰到那些圣洁的娜迦……

entries.source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
entries.target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

entries.source: Don't drink it, even if it tells you to.
entries.target: 不要去喝它，即使它诱惑着你……

entries.source: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
entries.target: 当操纵骨巨人的魔法力量消散后，它的遗骸化为了尘土。也许是你的幻觉，但这些尘土似乎偶尔会自行移动。

entries.source: Never, ever to be confused with garlic powder. Trust me.
entries.target: 绝对绝对不要和大蒜粉搞混，相信我……

entries.source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
entries.target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。

entries.source: If you've the means to eliminate the little venom problem, these make miraculous instant drink-chilling straws.
entries.target: 如果你有方法消除小小的毒液问题，这些螫针可以成为不可思议的冷冻吸管。

entries.source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
entries.target: 从米诺陶口鼻部割下来的前半截，连鼻环一起。

entries.source: You'll need to find one with a ring, preferably an expensive one.
entries.target: 你要寻找一个带有圆环的，最好是贵一些的那种。
一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液
